newsitem.title: USA: Nightwing to buy Congress Entertainment.
newsitem.headline: Nightwing to buy Congress Entertainment.

text.p: Nightwing Entertainment Group Inc said Wednesday that it entered into a definitive agreement to purchase the assets of Congress Entertainment, a division of a wholly-owned subsidiary of the New Jersey-based Creative Learning Products Inc.
The transaction involves the issuance of two million shares of Nightwing Entertainment common stock in exchange for assets of Congress Entertainment, it said.
The assets, valued at $330,000, will provide Nightwing with an active customer base, which generated for the fiscal year ending May 31, 1996, sales in excess of $720,000.
